name: Excel-Data-Analysis-Hotel-Booking-Demand-Huge-DataSet

CC0-1.0 licensed repo, but the actual data lives off-GitHub on OneDrive and is not linked to a stable public URL in the repo.
why_useful: Same underlying dataset already held by the team (Portugal hotel-booking demand, Antonio/Almeida/Nunes). This mirror adds nothing longer, older, or finer-grained -- it is a smaller single-year, single-property subset of data already in hand. Catalogued only to confirm no incremental value.
